explanation: Searched Mathlib for tower-style subsingleton propagation and injective-to-subsingleton results. Mathlib has the one-step lemma `Function.Injective.subsingleton` (`Mathlib/Logic/Unique.lean`), which the proof uses at each induction step, but the target additionally requires induction across the gap between thresholds. That is not a duplicate or a one- or two-line special case of a single Mathlib declaration.
